subject: Mythology
title: Medusa: Monster or Victim?
description: A fast breakdown of Medusa: Monster or Victim? for builders.

hook.text: Medusa is remembered as a monster, but she was once a beautiful priestess in Athena's temple.

buildup.text: Poseidon assaulted her in Athena's sacred space, violating both the woman and the goddess's temple.

discovery.text: Athena punished Medusa instead of Poseidon, turning her hair into snakes and her gaze into a curse.

twist.text: Modern readers see injustice: the victim was punished while the attacker walked free among the gods.

climax.text: Medusa's story has become a symbol of how myths can reveal ancient societies' darkest biases.

punchline.text: History called her a monster. The real monster was the story.

quiz.question: Why was Medusa transformed into a monster?
options: She boasted about being more beautiful than Athena
Athena punished her after Poseidon assaulted her in the temple
She stole a sacred artifact from Mount Olympus
